bio: With over 500 years of history to its name, plus a stylish interior, this moated castle near the Swiss border has for years been synonymous with classic French cuisine made from top-notch produce. You can dine à la carte or choose the set menu – there is also a vegetarian or vegan option. Accompany your food with one of the great wine recommendations. Our tip: The guesthouse 150m away has terrific rooms for overnight stays....
